title: One-affine-open extension of exhaustive finite subring models
statement:
Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, $V\subseteq X$ a quasi-compact open, and $U\subseteq X$ an affine open with $X=V\cup U$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Fix a selected finite affine gluing record $\mathsf H$ [def-nagata-finite-affine-gluing-presentation], enlarged and marked as in [def-nagata-finite-affine-subring-model], whose main affine charts are a finite affine cover of $V$ together with $U$. All other marked affine opens lie inside one of these main charts. Assign each auxiliary affine open to a main chart containing it. Write $\mathsf H_V$ for the subrecord on the main charts covering $V$ and the auxiliary affines assigned to those charts, with the maps, covers and equations involving those charts. Require this to be a finite gluing record for $V$; additional basic-open refinements may be fixed in advance to achieve this. Every marked affine open not in $\mathsf H_V$ is assigned to, and contained in, $U$, even when it also happens to lie in $V$. Maps from old marked opens to the new chart are requirements of $\mathsf H$, not assumed data of $\mathsf H_V$.

Suppose $I$ is a nonempty directed preorder (a reflexive transitive relation in which every two indices have a common upper bound) and $(B^i)_{i\in I}$ is a family of finite affine subring models of $\mathsf H_V$, with $B^i_P\subseteq B^j_P$ for $i\leq j$, and
$$\bigcup_{i\in I}B^i_P=\Gamma(P,\mathcal O_X)$$
for every marked affine $P$ of $\mathsf H_V$. Maps in this system are the actual inclusions and the restrictions specified by the model definition. No model for $X$ or for its new overlap with $U$ is assumed.

For every $i_0\in I$ and every finite seed $(E_P)_P$ in all the marked affine rings of $\mathsf H$, there exists a finite affine subring model $C$ of $\mathsf H$ such that
$$E_P\subseteq C_P\quad\text{for every marked affine }P,\qquad B^{i_0}_P\subseteq C_P\quad\text{for every }P\text{ in }\mathsf H_V.$$
The model $C$ realizes the original marked covers and basic-open identifications, including those inside $U\cap V$, and all its maps are restrictions of the original maps. This assertion adds one affine open to a supplied compatible exhaustive system on $V$; it does not assume or assert absolute approximation for an arbitrary $X$ without that input.

source.place: Tag 07RN (lemma-approximate), proof after reduction to X = U union V; Tag 01Z7 (lemma-quasi-affine-finite-type-over-Z), including optional prescribed finite elements; the finite marked-atlas and image-subring form also uses Tag 01ZM (lemma-descend-finite-presentation) after the one-open extension has been built, and Morphisms Tag 01R8 (lemma-quasi-compact-scheme-theoretic-image). These refinements are part of this statement, not claimed to follow from 07RN by one-line specialization.
